description: This Java source file defines the MainActivity class for an Android application. It manages the app's main UI, sets up a fragment, handles menu actions such as toggling the visibility of logs, and initializes custom logging mechanisms.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity for the NFC provisioning sample app, managing UI fragments, menu options, and logging setup.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the content view, and adds the NfcProvisioningFragment if no saved state exists.

methods.name: onPrepareOptionsMenu
methods.description: Prepares the menu by updating the toggle log item's visibility and title based on current state.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections, specifically toggling the log display.

methods.name: initializeLogging
methods.description: Sets up the custom logging chain, wrapping Android's log system, and configuring log views.
